exec.b: Joined as CEO in 2008 after a 20-year international career in technology, natural resources and government/defence. Co-founder and SVP of Quadrem; former Chief of Staff to Canada’s Minister of National Defence. Speaks five languages.
Joined in 2008 as Technical Director after a decade leading UK Defence procurement programmes. Managing Director UK from 2014, VP Global Sales from 2019 and COO since 2021.
Joined in 2012 to lead the new Project Management Office, then ran all production operations, supply chain, quality and engineering. CBDO since November 2020.
Appointed CFO in 2025 after joining as Controller in 2018 and serving as VP Finance. Oversees finance, legal, HR and IT. CPA, CA.

Leads US business development across all branches of the Department of Defense and other government agencies. 18+ years in business development, strategic planning and program management; retired US Air Force SMSgt with 20 years of service.

advisory.n: Lt Gen Guy C. Swan III
